what: Teledyne makes instruments that sense and analyse: digital cameras and imaging sensors, test and measurement equipment, marine and environmental monitoring instruments, and aerospace and defence electronics.
customers: Defence contractors and governments, factory automation and machine vision customers, environmental agencies, and oceanographic and scientific users.
money: industrial and scientific cameras, infrared and X-ray imaging
moat: Hundreds of niche instruments where it is the leading supplier to markets too small for large competitors, sold into equipment certified around them.
risks: Machine vision demand has been weak with industrial capital spending
Growth depends partly on continued acquisitions
Return on invested capital of about 7% reflects goodwill from past deals
opportunities: Revenue grew about 8% last year with a 19% operating margin
Defence electronics demand has strengthened with European rearmament
Analysts see about 22% upside from current levels
watch: Organic order growth, especially in digital imaging.
